caLaw._note: General California law, NOT Marche facts. The only law statements any page may make; each with its official source. Not legal advice.

facts.text: Adults 21 and older can buy cannabis from state-licensed retailers with a valid government-issued photo ID.
Adults 21 and older may possess up to 28.5 grams of cannabis and up to 8 grams of concentrated cannabis.
Medicinal cannabis customers must be 18 or older and hold a valid physician's recommendation.
Smoking or vaping cannabis anywhere tobacco smoking is banned, and consuming cannabis in public places, is not allowed.
Never drive impaired; cannabis in a vehicle must be in a sealed container or the trunk.
Check that a business is licensed before you buy: the state lists every licence holder.

mmic.text: California's Medical Marijuana Identification Card (MMIC) program is voluntary and run by county health departments under the California Department of Public Health.
Applying for an MMIC requires a physician's recommendation for medicinal cannabis.
Purchases of medicinal cannabis by a qualified patient with a valid MMIC are exempt from sales and use tax (cannabis excise tax still applies).
